run_visualize_dialogue: run a Gradio interface to visualize dialogue histories from a JSONL file with chatbot and ground truth display
run_main_jsonl: run the main function to load a JSONL file and launch a conversation visualizer on port 9785
build_gradio_interface: build a Gradio interface with a number input, chatbot output, answer text, and ground truth text fields
parse_dialogue_history: parse dialogue history from JSONL entries extracting content and output pairs for chatbot display
launch_share_interface: launch a shareable Gradio interface on a custom server port for reviewing annotated dialogue datasets
